title: Ellywick Tumblestrum
storyline: Dungeons & Dragons: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms

entities.name: Ellywick Tumblestrum
entities.description: Green-aligned gnome bard from the Forgotten Realms, greatest bard in the Multiverse thanks to a wish from her Deck of Many Things.

entities.name: Deck of Many Things
entities.description: Deck whose lucky draw granted Ellywick a wish.

events.summary: A wish granted by a lucky draw from her Deck of Many Things makes Ellywick the greatest bard in the Multiverse.
events.quote: made her the greatest bard in the Multiverse

relations.quote: She forms an adventurer party with the wizard Hama Pashar
